shows.title: Combined with Modal Input Selector
shows.label: the Modal input show
shows.description: Combined v0 with a Modal input selector: one of Dave's inputs at a time (his moving picture, his scene's colours and pace, or his own pictures for each screen and the ropes) drives the river, at a strength chosen in mission control.
inputs: Dave's Modal canvas, scene and frames
shows.last_change: Fixture entry until the show is in shows.json

shows.title: The remembered river
shows.label: the remembered river
shows.description: The column relives one real day from Dry Creek's past every five minutes, chosen by Dave's agent: its rain, how high the river ran, night and day, with one surge of full light at its heaviest rain. The pool on the floor breathes; people standing still close by slow the light near them.
inputs: Dave's agent (remembered day, palette, knobs, heard)
shows.last_change: Fixture entry until the show is in shows.json

shows.title: The filling glass
shows.label: the filling glass
shows.description: Every rope and every screen is one canvas, painted by where each LED really is in the room. Water rises from the floor to the top like a glass filling, turbulent and sloshing, then drains all the way out and fills again (about 84 seconds a cycle).
inputs: the LED map and screens (calibration, measured tilts)
shows.last_change: Fixture entry, offered, until the real one is

shows.title: The river (all looks)
shows.label: the river (all looks)
shows.description: One show file with several looks: the remembered river, Fill my cup (simple) and Fill my cup (configurable). It fades between them without restarting TouchDesigner: on Auto, four loops of the remembered river, then one full cycle of Fill my cup (simple), again; on Manual, the chosen look stays.
inputs: Dave's agent (remembered day, palette, knobs, heard)
the LED map and screens (calibration, measured tilts)
shows.last_change: Fixture entry until the show is in shows.json
